aboutTitle: Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Timor-Leste
aboutSub: The official national statistics office of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste, established 2004.
missionBody: INETL's mission is to produce, compile, analyse, and disseminate official statistics on economic, social, demographic, environmental, and cultural conditions that serve Timor-Leste's population, government, and development partners.
visionBody: To be a trusted national statistical institution that provides high-quality, relevant, accessible, and timely statistics, enabling evidence-based decision-making for sustainable national development.
legalBody: INETL was established by Decree-Law No. 9/2004 of 1 December 2004 official national statistics institute of Timor-Leste, operating under the Ministry of Finance.
standardsBody: INETL aligns its statistical production with the UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS), and the SDG indicator framework.

strategicDataBody: Our programs form the backbone of the National Statistical System. Through cyclical censuses and continuous household and enterprise surveys, INETL ensures policymakers, researchers, and the public have access to robust evidence regarding Timor-Leste's evolving socioeconomic landscape.
collabSub: Working together to strengthen Timor-Leste's statistical capacity and data ecosystem.
partnerEcoBody: INETL actively collaborates with government ministries, international organizations, academic institutions, and the private sector to improve data quality, share methodologies, and promote data utilization across Timor-Leste.

aboutCensusBody1: The 2022 Population and Housing Census was conducted by INETL between 10 October and 9 November 2022. It is the fourth complete enumeration of Timor-Leste since independence in 2002.
aboutCensusBody2: The census collected data from all 1,340,513 residents across 13 municipalities, encompassing 289,127 households in 452 administrative posts and 2,228 sucos.
